<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-API-004</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Using the REST API</b></div><div class="fact"><small>HTTP status</small><b>429</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>REST API; device HTTP calls</b></div></div>

## Why it happens

The tenant profile limits how fast the REST API and devices may be called. The answer has a `retryAfter` field and a `Retry-After` header with the number of seconds to wait.

## Fix it

- Wait the given time and try again.
- Send fewer requests, for example read many values in one call, or have devices send less often.
- The system administrator can raise the rate limits in the [tenant profile](/docs/user-guide/tenant-profiles/#rate-limits).

## Check that it worked

Requests succeed again.
